headline: German Union IG Metall Reaches Pay Deal Amid Industrial Crisis
summary: German trade union IG Metall has reached a pay deal covering 3.7 million workers, raising wages in two stages while allowing struggling manufacturers to seek labor cost savings in exchange for job protection pledges.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy; nationwide labor agreements in manufacturing set benchmark labor cost trends for industrial sectors across the continent.

impacts.name: German Manufacturing
impacts.why: Wage settlements directly alter operating expenses and cost structures for industrial employers.
